verdict.rationale: Exposing a 2FA vault through a local programmatic endpoint is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Authy offering a local API, CLI, or agent-queryable endpoint for its stored codes or secrets. The Authy API/SDK and Verify API are server-side tools for sites to verify their own users, not access to a user's vault. Community workarounds (debug-mode Electron scripts, a deprecated Chrome extension, unofficial GitHub tools) are user-side hacks and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose the vault through a local programmatic endpoint an agent can query for codes and secrets without screen-scraping the app
